images.caption: Heisholt Lake occupies a former limestone quarry on Texada Island, British Columbia, Canada. In summer the lake is an idyllic swimming hole.

images.caption: Until 2010 the Ash Grove Cement Company operated a large limestone quarry at Blubber Bay on Texada Island, British Columbia, Canada. The mothballed facilities are right next to the island's current ferry terminal.
